'''Budhila Plaza''' was a location on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="LoneWolf">{{StoryCite|story=Lone Wolf: A Tale of Obi-Wan and Luke|book=SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story}}</ref> It shared its name with [[Budhila Hestilic Amura]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who created both the philosophy known as [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] and the Hutt [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Council of Elders]].<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
